summary: Free official central government registration conferring priority lending, tax exemptions, and government tender benefits.

steps.title: Aadhaar OTP authentication
steps.description: Enter entrepreneur's 12-digit Aadhaar number and verify via mobile OTP on official Udyam portal.

steps.title: PAN verification
steps.description: Enter business PAN card; system automatically fetches tax & turnover data from income tax database.

steps.title: Fill enterprise particulars
steps.description: Specify industry category (Manufacturing/Service), NIC 2/4/5-digit codes, and plant address.

steps.title: Declare employment and investment
steps.description: Enter total employees and plant/machinery investment value (excluding land & building).

steps.title: Generate Udyam Registration Certificate
steps.description: System generates permanent digital certificate with lifetime validity and dynamic verification QR code.
